Mortgage Offer and Illustration
Dear Mr Gareth Lloyd,
We are pleased to offer you a mortgage for the remortgage of the property shown above. Please read this
document carefully. It sets out the key features of the mortgage, what you will pay, and the conditions that apply.
This offer is valid until 22 March 2027.
1. Key features

Product 5 Year Fixed Remortgage 60%
Amount of loan £210,999.00 (includes product fee added to the loan)
Value of the property £420,000.00
Loan to value 50.2%
Mortgage term 20 years
Repayment method Capital and interest (repayment)
2. Interest rate
Your mortgage starts on a fixed rate of 4.19% for 60 months, until 31 October 2031. After that, it will move to our
Standard Variable Rate (SVR), currently 7.49%, for the rest of the term. The SVR can go up or down at any time.

3. What you will need to pay
Period Number of payments Monthly payment
Fixed rate at 4.19% 60 £1,299.84
SVR at 7.49% (assumed unchanged) 180 £1,607.25
The total amount you will have to repay, assuming rates do not change, is £367,295.28.
Illustration only: if the SVR were 1% higher when your fixed rate ends, your monthly payment could rise to about
£1,707.37. This is not a forecast.
4. Fees

A product fee of £999.00 applies. You asked us to add it to your loan, so you will pay interest on it. A valuation was
carried out at no cost to you.
5. Overpayments and early repayment charges
You can overpay up to 10% of the outstanding balance each year during the fixed-rate period without a charge. If
you pay more than this, or repay the mortgage in full during the fixed-rate period, an early repayment charge (ERC)
applies to the amount repaid:
Period Early repayment charge

Year 1 5% of the amount repaid
Year 2 4% of the amount repaid
Year 3 3% of the amount repaid
Year 4 2% of the amount repaid
Year 5 1% of the amount repaid
After the fixed-rate period No charge
6. Your obligations
Your home may be repossessed if you do not keep up repayments on your mortgage. You must keep the property
insured against fire and other risks for its full rebuilding cost. If you want to move home, this mortgage may be

transferred to a new property, subject to our lending criteria at the time.
7. Contact us
If you have questions about this offer, call our mortgage team on 01632 960412 (Monday to Friday, 8am to 8pm,
Saturday 9am to 1pm), quoting reference FBS-2026-104512.
Yours sincerely,
Mortgage Underwriting Team
Fernmoor Building Society
